title: The Night of a Thousand Tears
description: As Moff Gideon set his sights on Mandalore, the only thing he could settle for was the firebombing of the planet. That night, as Imperial forces invaded in force, it became known as the Night of a Thousand Tears. Probe Droids flew through the night air, blasting anything that moved, while KX-Series Imperial Security Droids cover all the ground in between. The destruction was so great that it scattered the different sects of Mandalorians to the far reaches the galaxy. The events of that night would forever mar the history of Mandalore.
